description: Aviation is a dataset listed in City of Baton Rouge open data portal (data.brla.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Baton Rouge. Polygon geometry with attributes displaying Aviation facilities in East Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana. Coverage: Baton Rouge. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Infrastructure. Its tags are heliport, gis, ebrp, aviation, airport. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) 5010 Airport Directory. The portal shows 2026-08-08 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-brla-gov-portal.
